fields.System.Title: OUT-204 — Lock balances to prevent double allocation
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a customer, I want stock promised to me to actually be there, so that I do not get
a delay email for something the system said was in stock.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given allocation has shortlisted candidate stock, then those balance rows are locked
  • before any reservation is written.
  • - Given the lock is acquired, then availability is re-checked under the lock before
  • committing.
  • - Given several locations, then their IDs are sorted before locking so lock order is
  • deterministic.
  • - Given twenty concurrent allocations of one unit against ten units, then exactly ten
  • succeed and ten are cleanly rejected — no exceptions, no partial writes.
  • - Given two allocations touching the same two locations in opposite order, then neither
  • deadlocks.
  • - Given the locked section, then it makes no external calls.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | outbound, inventory |
| Tables | stock_balance, reservation |
| Risks | Double allocation ([doc 09 §4.1](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)); deadlock ([doc 09 §4.2](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)); contention ([doc 09 §4.4](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)) |
| Tests | concurrency (mandatory) · load · deadlock |
